sourceArchiveInputs.treatment: Every canonical asset inherited unchanged. Edition 1.1 is not edited and remains independently verifiable.

Fourteen controlling addenda authored against the accepted normalization record for the fourteen Batch 2 jurisdictions. Each amends only listed statements in the retained review it names. No original review was overwritten.

Sources acquired after the Edition 1.1 cutoff, retained individually identified. Louisiana's six La. C.Cr.P. art. 986 mandatory statutory forms, retrieved article by article from the Louisiana State Legislature on 2026-08-03.

Edition 1.1 pending candidates re-evaluated. Adoption only where identity is already established; everything else carries its Edition 1.1 hold forward exactly, with the Edition 1.1 disposition preserved on every row.

newSourceGaps.requested_item: La. C.Cr.P. arts. 987, 988, 989, 991, 992 and 994 — the art. 986 mandatory statutory forms
newSourceGaps.reason: Edition 1.1 retained Arts. 990, 993, 995, 998 and 999.1 but not the six forms on which every Louisiana motion track depends. They existed in the repository only as generic multi-article browser prints, which carry no document ID, role or revision and can never be manifested, so they were invisible to the pending-amendment ledger. Edition 1.2 retains all six as individually identified packet-form candidates.
newSourceGaps.source_basis: Louisiana State Legislature current-text publication, retrieved article by article 2026-08-03
newSourceGaps.next_action: Re-read each article at the Legislature before field mapping; a statutory form changes by amendment rather than by revision stamp.
